item.title: Louisiana SNAP shoppers can earn produce bonuses at Walmart in Baton Rouge, New Orleans
item.description: The Louisiana Department of Health has expanded the Louisiana Carrot Initiative to Walmart stores in East Baton Rouge and Orleans parishes, giving SNAP recipients a 30-cent bonus for every dollar they spend on fresh produce, up to $25 per month.

item.title: Trump's border czar is pulling 700 immigration officers out of Minnesota immediately
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS (AP) — The Trump administration is reducing the number of immigration officers in Minnesota but will continue its enforcement operation that has sparked weeks of tensions and deadly confrontations, border czar Tom Homan said Wednesday. About 700 federal officers — roughly a quarter of the total deployed to Minnesota — will be withdrawn immediately [...]

item.title: Testimony starts in Baton Rouge trial of Nevaeh Allen's mother
item.description: Opening statements began Wednesday in the trial of Lanaya Cardwell, a woman charged with second-degree cruelty to juveniles in connection with the death of her daughter, Neveah Allen.

item.title: City of Zachary enhances security ahead of first ever Mardi Gras celebration
item.description: The city of Zachary is preparing for its first-ever Mardi Gras celebration while officials implement new safety measures following a recent parade shooting in a neighboring community. The city is increasing police presence and updating tactical plans to ensure the safety of attendees.

item.title: 'It's Hunting Season': Southern baseball eager to prove doubters wrong this season
item.description: The mantra for Southern baseball this season is "It's hunting season," and the whole team bought into it during the offseason. The new motto originates from back-to-back early exits in the postseason and proving the doubters who are overlooking them wrong. The Jags were picked to finish sixth in the SWAC preseason poll with only one first-place vote.
